title: Joel's impossible choice at the end of The Last of Us
subject: joel
description:
Would you have saved Ellie or the world? 👇

Joel Miller's choice at the Firefly hospital and the price he paid for it. Spoilers for The Last of Us Part I and Part II.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Naughty Dog or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Joel chose one girl over a cure for all of humanity.
The Fireflies revealed the truth: a vaccine meant surgery on Ellie's brain, and she wouldn't survive.
Joel fought through the hospital, killed the surgeon, and carried her out.
When she woke, he lied that the Fireflies had given up. She made him swear, and he did.
But that's not the end. Years later, the surgeon's daughter, Abby, found him and took her revenge.
Joel had already told Ellie he would do it all over again.
He never regretted saving her, even when it cost him everything.
